requestBody.description: The certificate in PEM form (`certificate`) and, for a custom certificate, its private key (`certificate_key`), as form fields holding files of at most 1 MiB each

200.description: What was read from the files

certificate.issuer: C = US, O = Example CA, CN = Example Issuing CA

cn.description: The names the certificate is valid for: its subject alternative names, or its common name when it has none

issuer.example: C = US, O = Example CA, CN = Example Issuing CA

dates.description: When the certificate is valid, as Unix time in seconds

certificate_key.description: Whether the private key is readable and matches the certificate; absent when no key was sent

400.description: A file is not a valid certificate or key, the certificate has expired, or the key does not match

error.message: Certificate Key does not match the Certificate

description:
Checks an uploaded certificate and key without storing anything: the key must be readable, the certificate valid and not expired, and the two must match. Send multipart form data. Only the files you send are reported; a failed check answers 400 with the reason.
Needs: Certificates manage
